title: bn254-gt-dlp: (6,2) STNFS behind a run gate, logarithm phase at its metered expectation: 2^94.692710594

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x with g^x=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) x 2^95.878141297 < 2^94.692710594 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). This is an expectation over the gate coin, the challenge and the run, not a bound on every run. The attack first reads a fresh uniform 64-bit coin and opens the run only when it is below K = 8110908889635556449 (K/2^64 < 0.439694); a closed run is a failure below one unit. An opened run succeeds with probability at least 0.886982 and has expected work at most 2^95.878141297 units. Both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^99 units that aborts as failure; the ledger charges the logarithm phase at its metered expectation (1+2^-13) E[D] with E[D] <= 2^95.805191 from the descent recurrence (H5), not at the meter cap, so the expected-work bound depends on the descent model, as does the success bound through Markov P(cap) <= (1+2^-13) E[D]/2^99 <= 0.109225. Each indivisible log-phase step is reserved at its priced bound and refused if it would exceed the meter, metering included. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; the log phase is charged at its metered expectation, the meter 2^99 enters success, and check [8] verifies the run gate; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
